activity.permitted_processes_used: Bounded benign local Python pipe/watchdog fixtures only, with synthetic metadata, explicit fake delegates and fake Docker runners. No real container/healthcheck/native actor was started or stopped.

artifact_contract.immutability_limit: Exclusive creation, read-only final mode and a separately returned SHA-256 bind this review; no kernel immutable-flag claim is made.

closures.implemented_remedy: WatchdogProcess requires an explicit cleanup_authorizer to return the boolean True for cleanup and the validated scope digest before creating a process. The child repeats that decision before journal creation/READY. The default backend has no authorizer when none is supplied; when supplied, its wrapper admits cleanup only, binds the exact scope, and invokes the supplied delegate at each cleanup method entry.
closures.remaining_contract: The delegate is trusted outer-assembly policy, not an approval issuer implemented by this layer. Production must supply an independently approved, scope-bound, owner-independent cleanup delegation; the test grant is synthetic and conveys no real execution authority.

reproduction.adaptation: All operational watchdog probes supply a valid spawn-safe synthetic outer delegate and the new three-argument backend factory. Default-policy tests inject FakeCLI at DockerBackend construction, so evidence_kind remains simulated. No unsupported v1 call shape is treated as proof of closure.

semantic_closure_proof: A correct full inventory and valid references passed to the real default factory without a delegate were refused by all six mutation entry points with EXECUTION_NOT_APPROVED before any fake CLI call.
Missing, deny, integer-1 and wrong-scope delegates were refused before multiprocessing context creation, with CLEANUP_NOT_DELEGATED.

A spawn-safe callback deliberately allowing only its parent was invoked successfully in the parent and denied in the actual child before READY/journal creation. Closure is supported by recorded callback decisions and distinct process IDs, not by a pickling/signature failure.

With valid explicit delegation, the separate-session worker used the real default-backend policy and actual cleanup algorithm over a fake CLI transport. It completed three synthetic kills, three supported waits and five removals; thirteen delegate invocations covered parent bootstrap, child bootstrap and eleven cleanup operations.
Revocation between cleanup calls denied kill, wait and remove without any new fake CLI call. Create/start/actor-input actions and a different scope were refused by the cleanup-only wrapper.
Owner EOF did not remove delegated cleanup authority: five synthetic resources were removed and the exact retained cleanup journal was successfully reconciled.
closures.title: Default watchdog no longer manufactures cleanup authority from the scope

closures.implemented_remedy: Both image and container admission call disabled_healthcheck. It permits only absent metadata or Test=['NONE'] with an allowlisted set of exact integer-zero optional fields. Container admission also refuses State.Health. Every role's create argv contains --no-healthcheck.
closures.remaining_contract: No healthcheck or container was executed. These tests establish closed metadata/argv handling, not real Docker or kernel admission or exact-image approval.

reproduction.adaptation: Image probes use real canonical private profile files and valid role specs/authorizers. The activation probe passes the new full snapshot argument rather than the obsolete volumes-only argument. Positive controls traverse the same admitted paths.

semantic_closure_proof: For target, oracle and observer, valid image metadata with an added CMD or CMD-SHELL healthcheck reached image inspection and was rejected with HEALTHCHECK before container-create dispatch: six negative variants.

Absent and disabled image healthchecks passed otherwise identical valid profiles/specs/delegation and produced exactly one --no-healthcheck flag for each role: six positive creation variants, all fake.

Twenty-seven malformed or executable container-healthcheck variants were rejected, including command arrays, missing/empty/string Test, extra Test elements, unknown fields, boolean retry counts and nonzero intervals. Nine valid absent/disabled variants were admitted.

All three roles rejected populated State.Health. An otherwise valid target with full generation-10 inventory and fresh attachments was rejected specifically at HEALTHCHECK before the stream factory was invoked.
closures.title: Inherited executable healthchecks are rejected and creation explicitly disables healthchecks

closures.implemented_remedy: The parent retains the exact initial READY and deep copies each successfully acknowledged snapshot. Final validation unconditionally requires journal_intact=true, checks retained bytes and file identity, requires the exact ready/armed*/triggered/cleanup event shape, matches each armed payload in order against the acknowledged snapshots, and binds the trigger and final payload. Worker cleanup is independent of journal append success; parent error paths close IPC and boundedly join the supervisor.
closures.remaining_contract: Journal reconciliation validates retention and binding, not the truth of a malicious backend's observations. The host controller/worker and private bootstrap remain trusted. Native actors receive no private watchdog IPC endpoint. No general runtime or remote absence proof is conferred by a simulated cleanup receipt.

reproduction.adaptation: Tamper/forgery probes use parents initialized through valid v2 spawn/delegation/READY and fully acknowledged valid inventories. The positive final reply is first accepted before offline validator mutations. Missing attributes, invalid signatures, permission denials and old interfaces are not counted as semantic closure.

semantic_closure_proof: A real benign watchdog with explicit valid delegation and all eleven generation-0-through-10 snapshots had its private test journal modified in place. Parent close rejected with WATCHDOG_RETENTION_UNPROVEN, while the fake-transport audit showed all five safe removals completed; the supervisor was reaped with exit code zero.

Starting from an originally accepted complete reply and an initialized real parent object, a false journal_intact flag plus a missing journal was rejected. The old skip-reconciliation path no longer succeeds.

Eight same-file, self-consistently rehashed journal variants were rejected at the intended checks: all armed rows missing, one missing, reorder, cross-case substitution, extra armed row, different initial READY, different trigger and different final payload. The unmodified original was then accepted again.
Wrong file mode, additional hard link, replacement inode and changed retained bytes were refused; restoring the original made the same result validate again.

A deliberately lost acknowledgement after a valid worker ACK poisoned the registry. Parent validation refused the child's unacknowledged inventory rather than crediting completion; worker cleanup was still retained.

Verified retention did not upgrade candidate-only absence into settled creation or complete cleanup. Both candidate-only and complete positive controls retained execution_authorized=false and simulated evidence labeling.
closures.title: Final cleanup claims require intact retention and the exact acknowledged journal prefix

correctness_coupling_checks.evidence: Authorized full cleanup uses container wait ID without the unsupported condition option. An independent fake wait-success/ineffective-stop probe confirmed that nonzero PID/running state still prevents removal; the wait reply alone is not quiescence.
Target FINISHED and observer CONTINUATION_DISPATCHED fragments without newline both caused EARLY_ACTOR_OUTPUT before any G/R dispatch bytes were written. Owned stream cleanup still completed.

correctness_coupling_checks.change: Full activation inventory and fresh attachment check
correctness_coupling_checks.evidence: All three actor roles accepted valid complete metadata-only inventories with a fake stream factory. Each refused incomplete inventory and a foreign attachment on either volume: three incomplete and six attachment negatives. No actor was launched.

correctness_coupling_checks.change: Authorization recheck after create/start admission reads
correctness_coupling_checks.evidence: Delegate revocation between initial authorization and final dispatch denied create-volume, create-container and start. Actor-input permission was separately rechecked using the new full-snapshot API.

correctness_coupling_checks.change: Collect queued final after broken cleanup-request write
correctness_coupling_checks.evidence: Both BrokenPipeError and ConnectionResetError on the cleanup-request write allowed collection of an already queued real watchdog deadline reply, which still underwent retained-journal validation. Supplied tests also cover the natural late-close path.

correctness_coupling_checks.change: Explicit simulated evidence for injected transports
correctness_coupling_checks.evidence: Constructor-injected runner and stream factories each label the backend simulated. All default-policy semantic probes inject at construction and retain that label.

independent_checks.guard: Reviewer audit guard rejects non-Python subprocess.Popen launches, external network connect/bind/name-resolution requests and persistent writes outside rereview. All explicitly spawned fixture interpreters use -B; private AF_UNIX multiprocessing pipes are local IPC. Popen's existing null device stdin open is not a persistent output. This is not syscall tracing or a real-runtime attestation.

semantic_probes.interpretation: All twenty-one test methods passed on first execution; individual methods include multiple positive and negative cases. No interface failure is used as finding closure.

supplied_record.interpretation: Hash-bound supplied result plus verified log hashes; not represented as 78 independently rerun tests.

known_incomplete_future_assembly_not_sou: Independent runtime kernel/process/namespace identity, capabilities and installed security-profile admission evidence.
Oracle worker/client-frame closure bridge, runtime clock/hold/continuation evidence and complete per-trial orchestration.
Exact runtime-image and approval binding to a separate reviewed outer execution decision.
Approval issuance, a run CLI and a full executable OBS1/M4 execution packet are not supplied by this layer.

preservation.independence: No peer reviewer findings or subagents were consulted. Only this review's new rereview directory was written.
preservation.native_artifact_limit: The eleven artifact digests agree with the prior bound verification/foundation records; not all eleven native binaries/headers are materialized in the snapshots, so this is not a fresh independent read of all artifact bytes. Available retained files are covered by full snapshot preservation. No build/native execution was used.

residual_trust_and_limits: Trusted host-side authorizer/backend factories are passed through Python's trusted spawn bootstrap. This is distinct from the private raw-byte watchdog control channel; no untrusted pickle-receive authority is introduced.
Fake Docker and metadata predicates are not observations of a real Docker daemon, Linux arm64 runtime, capless tracing, native capability state or remote absence.

Outer approval/delegation policy, host controller/worker and Docker daemon remain trusted. Metadata polling does not purport to defeat an actively malicious Docker administrator or atomically prevent every name-based volume replacement race.
No new source defect was identified in this focused rereview, but that is not a whole-runtime security certification or execution authorization.

scope.foundation_reuse: Prior foundation review is reused. The complete v1-to-v2 snapshot comparison found only the eight declared changes, with controller.role_spec, contracts, D02, native inputs, protocol and Redis runtime unchanged. No full foundation re-audit or build was performed.

summary: SEC-C0-001, SEC-C0-002 and SEC-C0-003 are semantically closed in the bound v2 snapshot. Positive controls exercised valid new delegation and inventory contracts; negative controls reached the intended security checks. No new blocking source issue was identified in the eight-file delta or the reviewed couplings. GO is limited to continued implementation, not execution or runtime acceptance.
